raw_market.description:
In the first half of the college football game between Texas and Oklahoma, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Oklahoma score 11 or more points in the first half.

If Oklahoma score less than 11 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on Oklahoma's score, not the combined score of both teams.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
